admission.justification: The delayed-runner test releases a receipt after cancellation; the rule prevents a late host reply from restarting an attempt the developer stopped.

applicability: Late host receipts applied to durable presenter attempts.
conditions: The fresh locked record is settled: its state is outside started and running.
exclusions: A receipt for a started attempt, which may transition to running.
The separate publication-result transition, which is not a host receipt.
statement: A delayed host receipt must not change a settled presenter attempt back to a live state.
